digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI; Mgombato (chiburu)

teaser.en: 'Water gourd' — a name that may hint at an old use for its pods, though no one has confirmed it.
teaser.sw: 'Kibuyu cha maji': jina ambalo huenda linadokeza matumizi ya zamani ya maganda yake, ingawa hakuna aliyethibitisha.

summary.en: *Chiburu madzi* is a slender twining plant of the milkweed group. Its name means 'water gourd', but Pakia couldn't confirm what the name refers to.
summary.sw: *Chiburu madzi* ni mmea mwembamba unaojizungusha, wa kundi la milkweed. Jina lake maana yake ni 'kibuyu cha maji', lakini Pakia hakuweza kuthibitisha jina hilo linarejelea nini.

about.en: *Secamone retusa* is a slender, twining climber of the milkweed group, with small opposite leaves notched at the tip and tiny flowers. Like its relatives, its fruits are paired pods that split to release seeds with tufts of silky hair. Pakia records it as a herb and notes that Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Secamone retusa* ni mtambaaji mwembamba unaojizungusha, wa kundi la milkweed, wenye majani madogo yanayoelekeana, yaliyo na kibonyeo kwenye ncha, na maua madogo sana. Kama ilivyo kwa jamaa zake, matunda yake ni maganda ya jozi ambayo hupasuka na kutoa mbegu zenye vishungi vya nywele laini kama hariri. Pakia anauandika kuwa mmea mdogo (herb) na anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It twines through bush and thicket on the East African coast.
where.sw: Hujizungusha katika vichaka na vichaka vizito kwenye pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: *Chiburu madzi* means 'water gourd': *chiburu* is a small gourd, which Mgombato describes as a gourd used to store seeds, milk or flour, and *madzi* is water. Pakia suggests the plant might produce gourds that were used to keep or carry water, but says this still needs to be confirmed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chiburu madzi* maana yake ni 'kibuyu cha maji': *chiburu* ni kibuyu kidogo, ambacho Mgombato anakieleza kuwa kibuyu kinachotumiwa kuhifadhi mbegu, maziwa au unga, na *madzi* ni maji. Pakia anapendekeza kwamba huenda mmea huu hutoa vibuyu vilivyotumiwa kuwekea au kubebea maji, lakini anasema jambo hili bado linahitaji kuthibitishwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Bottle gourd, the chiburu of the name
reason.sw: Mmea wa vibuyu (bottle gourd), ndio chiburu wa jina hili

reason.en: Parquetina, a climber of the same family
reason.sw: Parquetina, mtambaaji wa familia hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Pleurostelma, a twiner of the same family
reason.sw: Pleurostelma, mmea unaojizungusha wa familia hiyo hiyo

reason.en: Tylophora, another twiner of the same family
reason.sw: Tylophora, mmea mwingine unaojizungusha wa familia hiyo hiyo

mgombato: chiburu (vi) gourd used for storing seeds, milk, flour, etc; kitoma, buyu.
